registers.name: GICR_IGROUPR0
registers.description: Interrupt Group Register 0。GIC Redistributor (GICR) 寄存器

fields.name: Redistributor_group_status_bit<x>
fields.description: Group status bit. In this 寄存器: 当 GICD_CTLR.DS == 0, the bit that corresponds to the interrupt is concatenated with the equivalent bit in GICR_IGRPMODR0 to form a 2-bit 字段 that defines an interrupt group. The encoding of this 字段 is at GICR_IGRPMODR0. [0b0=当 GICD_CTLR.DS==1, the corresponding interrupt is Group ; 0b1=当 GICD_CTLR.DS==1, the corresponding interrupt is Group ]
